reason: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin that provides Sessions/Files navigation, lazy workspace directory browsing, file path copying, and sending selected files to the agent.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏中提供会话与文件标签、懒加载工作区文件树、复制路径以及将文件发送给智能体的操作。
summaries.en: Adds Sessions and Files tabs to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with a lazy-loaded workspace file tree, copy-path actions, and an option to send files to the agent.

capabilities: Displays a lazy-loaded workspace file tree in a sidebar
Reads directory listings through a plugin HTTP route
Copies file paths to the clipboard
Sends a selected file to the current agent as a prompt
